query: The 2026 FIFA World Cup kicks off at Estadio Azteca on June 11, 2026.
answer: The 2026 FIFA World Cup opens on June 11 at Estadio Azteca in Mexico City with Mexico vs. South Africa. The tournament features 48 teams across 12 groups. The final is on July 19 in New York.

### Which 2026 World Cup matches are taking place in Mexico City?

The 2026 World Cup's "Estadio Azteca Mexico City" is set to host five matches. Specifically, they are three in the group stage, one in the Round of 32 and one in the Round of 16. Estadio Azteca will serve as the host for the opening match of the 2026 World Cup on June 11, as the Mexico National Soccer Team will aim to start off the tournament on the right foot in this match.

### Apart from Mexico City, are there any World Cup matches scheduled in other cities in Mexico?

Mexico City is one of three Mexican cities that will serve as a host of World Cup 2026 matches. You can see every Mexican city featured in World Cup 2026 below, along with the name of the venue in each city. [...] ## About World Cup 2026 tickets in Mexico City

Mexico City will hold a pivotal place in the 2026 World Cup, with matches set to take place at the iconic Estadio Azteca in the heart of the capital. Estadio Azteca is legendary for its place in football history and is one of the few stadiums to host multiple World Cups. The World Cup's "Estadio Azteca Mexico City" will host five matches in total: three group-stage games, one Round of 32 match and one Round of 16 match. As the tournament opens on June 11, 2026 at this very venue, Mexico City will set the tone for the global event.

## How are teams eliminated from the group stage?

Each team will need to finish either in its group’s top two or rank in the top eight third-place teams to advance to the round of 32. Teams that place fourth in their group will not advance. The round of 32 will kick off June 28.
